target: Arquitectura exterior del asentamiento secundario Vado de Juncos, transición Edran/Lethra.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: ARCHITECTURE / SETTLEMENT — NO CREATURE. Pequeño asentamiento sobre terreno alto que adapta el viaje entre camino firme, pasarela y agua.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: ARCHITECTURE / SETTLEMENT — NO CREATURE. Create a wide exterior architectural scene of the canonical Vado de Juncos. A small cluster of practical shelters occupies slightly raised firm ground where an Edran road reaches Lethra wetlands. Show the transition from wagon-width earth track to simple elevated footways and water access. Structures use modest timber, stone footings and weather-resistant coverings, arranged to stay above wet ground. Reeds and shallow channels surround but do not engulf the settlement. It is a route-support hamlet, not a major village.
negative_constraints: No large harbor, market city, palace or fortress
No magical water, glow or fantasy ornaments
No characters or creatures as focal subject
canon_sources: vintage-telnet/REGIONAL_CONNECTIONS.md — Camino de la Tierra Húmeda
notes: Asentamiento secundario canónico; función de cruce y adaptación, sin economía inventada.
